page.layout: One printed page. Heading across the top: "Typographus studiosis", then the greeting "S. P. D." centred. Below, one column of running text in italic with a large initial A. No marginal notes. Catchword "non" at the lower right.

p.i: fflictam[?] Philosophiam funestā morte solidissimi Philosophi D. Franconis Burgersdicij p. m. celeberrima Lugd. Academia, totusque Philosophorum chorus merito lugent: ut tamen justissimo huic dolori subveniretur, & damnum hoc aliquatenus resarciretur, voluerunt Reverendi ac Doctissimi quidam Viri, ut hujus Philosophi opera, huc usque cum multorum dispendio in tenebris latitantia, lucem aspicerent; quapropter me adhortarunt, ut praesertim hanc Metaphysicam, quam ipse in Collegio dictaverat, in lucem ederem: consulebant quippe hoc pacto tum famae & existimationi ipsius Authoris, (multorum enim in manibus versabantur multoties vitiose descripta exemplaria) tum publicae utilitati. Opus hoc Philosophiae studiosis absolutè necessariū est, & quidquid contra garriant bonarum artium contemptores, Theologis non

page.notes: The large initial A is joined to the first word. The first word of the body is partly unclear in the scan and is marked [?]. The top edge blur and the small mark at lower left are not printed text and are left out.
